title: Ještěd Tower
scope: Ještěd’s standing mountain hotel, restaurant, transmitter and attached summit gallery above Liberec.
limitations: The cadastral geometry includes the wider access deck. Intermediate levels, antenna supports and the series of skirting and glazing bands are estimated from the photo and documented public elevations.
The antenna and reinforcement hardware are simplified. The rock, retaining steps and walkway details use the measured slope with estimated architectural profiles.
